Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed — each only where the geometry has room
   for it; one with nowhere to go is left out, never forced into the roadway.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2005
Post-9/11 era. An aging 2005 strip mall — national franchises mixed with struggling locals, the video store on its last legs.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- dollar store anchor with yellow 'EVERYTHING $1' signage
- cellular store with carrier logos and 'FREE FLIP PHONE' posters
- hair salon with a 'WALK-INS WELCOME' sign
- a RadioShack store, red sign board with white lettering
- window signs: 'FOOTLONG COMBO $5.99', 'NAIL FILL $18'
- a sidewalk sandwich board with a cell-phone store promo
- light poles with faded banner ads
Typography: clean sans-serif, polished brand identities.
Place each detail where it plausibly belongs — sidewalk, storefront, lot edge, under an overhang. If there is nowhere for one, leave it out; nothing stands in the roadway or a driving lane.

SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'EVERYTHING $1'
'FREE FLIP PHONE'
'WALK-INS WELCOME'
'FOOTLONG COMBO $5.99'
'NAIL FILL $18'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 9 people TOTAL: 4 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 3 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a couple browsing the closing video store's bargain bins
- a family piling out of an SUV near the entrance
- a jogger checking a heart-rate monitor watch mid-stride
Clothing: men in frosted tips hair, baggy jeans; women in chunky highlights, low-rise jeans. Fashion palette: denim, pink, white. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 5 period vehicles, all different:
- 2003-2007 Honda Accord — clean lines, sharper than 1990s — silver
- 2001-2007 Ford Escape — compact boxy SUV — white
- 2002-2006 Toyota Camry — smooth conservative mid-size — dark blue
- 2002-2007 Jeep Liberty — round-headlight compact SUV — black
- 2002-2009 Chevrolet TrailBlazer — mid-size SUV boxy — gold
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 2005 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 2005, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 2005.
Parked vehicles sit nose-in or angled into the lot, evenly spaced; none parallel-parked along the street, none blocking a driveway apron. Keep the driveway aprons and the drive lanes through the lot clear.
PLACEMENT: three nose-in near the building; the rest in stalls at the far edge of the lot. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, turn arrows
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable and fiber lines on poles appearing

TREES
- crepe myrtle tree at parking lot island near entrance: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 50% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- maple tree at landscape strip along the road: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 75% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- oak tree at back property line: slightly smaller than in the base image — about 90% of its canopy there
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the base image.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — early digital camera or Kodak/Fuji consumer film look.
Color: neutral tones. Grain: low grain, early digital noise in shadows.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.
Light: warm, bright afternoon daylight, clear sky with light cloud, soft natural shadows — a fine, ordinary day.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 2003-2007 Honda Accord — clean lines, sharper than 1990s
